info.description:
A multi-cloud Blueprint API for VCF Automation

This page describes the RESTful APIs for Blueprint. The APIs facilitate CRUD operations on the various resources and entities used throughout Blueprint (Blueprints, PropertyGroups , etc.) and allow operations on them (creating a Blueprint, creating a Property group, etc.).

The APIs that list collections of resources  also support OData like implementation. Below query params can be used across Blueprint entities.

Example:

1. `$orderby` - returns a result with the rows being sorted by the values of provided attribute.

    ```/blueprint/api/blueprints?$orderby=name%20desc```

2. `$top`, `$skip` - `$top` returns the requested number of resources. Used with `$skip`, the client can skip a given number of resources.

    ```/blueprint/api/blueprints?$top=10&$skip=2```

organizationSharings.description: List of organizations with whom the given blueprint is either shared with or needs to be shared with. If share with all the organizations, there should be one organizationSharing in the array with orgId as 'ALL'.

requestScopeOrg.description: Flag to indicate blueprint can be requested from any project in org

dependsOnResources.description: Resource depends on other resources in the plan

items.description: Resource depends on other resources in the plan

deploymentName.description: Name for the new catalog instance

destroy.description: Destroy existing catalog instance, if it set to true. Default value is false.

ignoreDeleteFailures.description: Ignore delete failures in blueprint request

plan.description: Plan only without affecting existing catalog instance, if set to true. Default value is false. Cannot be combined with other flags like simulate.

simulate.description: Simulate blueprint request with providers, if set to true. Default value is false. Cannot be combined with other flags like Plan.

release.description: Flag indicating version should be released

sourceControlPush.description: Flag indicating version should be pushed to source control

FormLayoutSchema.description: Form layout schema this request is made for

createdAt.description: The time at which given blueprint was initially shared with given tenant organization

createdBy.description: Represents the entity who shared the given blueprint with given tenant organization

orgId.description: ID of the organization which the given blueprint is shared with or needs to be shared with. If share with all the organizations, value should be to 'ALL'.

updatedAt.description: The time at which given blueprint was re-shared with given tenant organization

updatedBy.description: Represents the entity who updated the sharing of given blueprint with given tenant organization

OrganizationSharing.description: List of organizations with whom the given blueprint is either shared with or needs to be shared with. If share with all the organizations, there should be one organizationSharing in the array with orgId as 'ALL'.

$dynamicDefault.description: Path that can be used to retrieve single permissible default value

$dynamicEnum.description: Path that can be used to retrieve permissible values

encrypted.description: Flag indicating if property is encrypted

enum.description: Restrict a value to a fixed set of values for the property

items.description: Restrict a value to a fixed set of values for the property

format.description: The expected (and pre-defined) format to be used for string validations. Supported format values include: date-time, email, ip-address, alphanumeric, phone, etc.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items for the property

maxLength.description: String instance is validated against this keyword for its maximum length

minItems.description: Minimum number of items for the property

minLength.description: String instance is validated against this keyword for its minimum length

oneOf.description: Ensures the given data is valid against only one of the specified schemas

pattern.description: Regular expression to express constraint for the property

readOnly.description: Flag indicating if property is read only

type.description: Property type should be among valid types (number, integer, string, array, boolean, object)
